Always s, never z: a pessoa, ah peh-SOH-uh. A single s between vowels is z: a casa.
g before e or i sounds zh: a página, ah PAH-zhee-nuh. Before a, o or u it is a hard g: a garrafa.
Usually sh: a caixa, ah KAI-shuh. In some words it is ks (o táxi, oo TAHK-see), z (o exame) or s (próximo).
A stressed ah: o cardápio, oo kahr-DAH-pyoo.
